W09-P05.headline: A Round of Answers
W09-P05.deck: A charity invitation. A familiar rival. Nothing casual about the round.
W09-P05.body_copy: The invitation promised a morning for a good cause. The round exposed less charitable intentions. Duckhook knew every ridge of his own course; ObiWan had returned with a memory the host would rather forget. A clean strike earned a glance. A ball in the rough earned silence. By the time they walked toward the green, the autumn light was still beautiful. Neither rival was looking at it.

sports_insert.required_after_final: One verified starter/lineup cause tied to the winning/losing golf sequence; no invented stroke totals or false real-world charity receipts.

layout.reading_order: TOP_TO_BOTTOM; identical characters recur across sequential moments, not simultaneous clones

action_blocks.framing: Wide three-quarter fairway view; club and follow-through clear of faces
action_blocks.action: Duckhook completes a balanced driver follow-through. ObiWan stands off the swing arc at the rear tee marker, watching the same ball flight.
action_blocks.contact: Both hands visibly share one golf-club grip; one club shaft, no duplicated arm. Ball has left the tee, no impact spark.
action_blocks.axis: Fairway runs lower-left to upper-right; clubhouse on horizon left, pond right.
action_blocks.neutrality: Ball trajectory does not establish a score, winner, or collapse.

action_blocks.framing: Medium side view of ObiWan at bunker edge; Duckhook beyond safe swing space
action_blocks.action: ObiWan makes a sand recovery stroke, knees flexed and torso rotating; sand fan and the released ball separate clearly from his club.
action_blocks.contact: Boots planted at different depths; hands hold one club, green sword stays sheathed and does not substitute for equipment.
action_blocks.axis: Same fairway direction and pond side; golden retriever stays outside the play corridor if shown.
action_blocks.neutrality: The proof shows the attempt, not confirmed success or humiliation.

action_blocks.framing: Tight two-shot reaction at a greenside pause, not a repeat of P06 final-green map
action_blocks.action: Duckhook folds the unnumbered scorecard shut as ObiWan tightens his grip; each stops smiling and checks the other rather than posing toward the camera.
action_blocks.contact: Scorecard, club grip, duck bill and human face stay separated; no winning stroke is shown.
action_blocks.axis: Flag uphill in middle distance; short apron visibly slopes toward pond on right.
action_blocks.neutrality: No sunk ball, trophy, scoreboard victory or despair before result selection.

W09-P20.headline: No Safe Corner
W09-P20.deck: Two contenders. Changing angles. No comfortable position.
W09-P20.body_copy: The first volley stripped the comfort out of cover. Slob drove forward between the trees while TDS watched the openings from three different angles. Paint snapped against the bunkers. A shoulder appeared, vanished, then appeared somewhere else. Neither competitor could afford to wait for a perfect shot. Every move gained ground and surrendered protection. Somewhere beyond the next barrier, one clean angle was waiting.

sports_insert.required_after_final: Verified player/lineup pressure; no made-up hits, elimination or final score.

action_blocks.action: Slob moves from the southwest cylindrical bunker toward central low cover. TDS leans from a northeast wedge, three protected heads separated against a clean background.
action_blocks.contact: Slob’s leading foot presses turf; his supporting hand steadies the marker. TDS has only one pair of arms and one marker, not three armed bodies.
action_blocks.axis: Slob left/near; TDS right/far; common open middle lane. Tree line and distant camp stay north/back.
action_blocks.impact: Paint hits the inflatable cover, never either player. No elimination cue.

action_blocks.framing: Medium sideline inset; no faceless helmet crop
action_blocks.action: Slob lowers into a short slide behind central cover; heavy body compresses clothing and scuffs grass while face protection stays in place.
action_blocks.contact: Legs remain connected and direction of soil spray follows motion. Preserve current October18 heavyset human presentation, not old horned redesign text.
action_blocks.axis: Movement continues left-to-right from the dominant frame.
action_blocks.impact: Incoming paint splashes the cover edge, not his visor.

action_blocks.framing: Medium cover-edge inset showing all three head silhouettes
action_blocks.action: TDS changes from northeast wedge to adjacent rear tree cover; central head tracks lane while outer heads check flanks.
action_blocks.contact: Three head-specific face protections, visible neck continuity, two feet and one shared body. Marker stays below head silhouettes.
action_blocks.axis: Facing left toward Slob with background tree line unchanged.
action_blocks.impact: TDS remains unhit; neither side is declared superior.

W09-P31.emotional_spine: Hospitality becomes a personal contest; the course stays beautiful while the rivals lose their composure.
W09-P31.ground_plan: Readable shot axis: tee/fairway runs lower-left toward upper-right. Clubhouse remains horizon-left and pond camera-right. At the final green, the flag is uphill of a visible short apron descending to the pond. Opponent stays outside every swing arc.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: Duckhook waits by the first tee as ObiWan approaches; small removable charity signs sit beside the path, not over the landscape.
beats.what_changes: A welcoming public occasion and home advantage become visible.
beats.transition: Cut closer only when the visitor reaches the host.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: Duckhook offers the card; ObiWan takes its edge. Courteous smiles coexist with held eye contact and squared shoulders. No invented wager or readable stroke total.
beats.what_changes: Courtesy becomes a recognizable personal challenge.
beats.transition: Match the hand on the card to hands settling on a club.

Which branch is hypothetical rather than an announced winner?

W09-P32.emotional_spine: Cocky familiarity becomes vulnerability; knowledge must turn into a changed decision, not mere bravery.
W09-P32.ground_plan: A raised start bank looks across a low channel toward an elevated finish banner. A root-bound berm runs around the near edge. Floodwater crosses the low channel toward the basin; these positions do not change between shots.

beats.shot: Wide start bank with long horizon
beats.pose_and_physical_action: Mud Dogs sets off as the approved four-legged swamp hound on the proposed canine-compatible dirt-bike rig. Forepaws use supported grips, hind paws rest behind; muzzle and moss stay visible. The far-bank humanoid El Niño, channel, berm and finish establish all actors and geography.
beats.what_changes: Home familiarity and a tangible destination are established.
beats.transition: Cut to the rider noticing the changing sky.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: The swamp hound turns his canine head toward El Niño and the gathering storm on the far bank, then shifts forward over the low saddle to accelerate instead of taking higher ground.
beats.what_changes: Ignoring the warning is a choice, not an unexplained accident.
beats.transition: Follow rear-wheel spray into the same channel seen in the wide.

W09-P32.page_turn_out: He saw the storm and accelerated; what does his chosen route become?
text_hidden_review_questions: Can the reader see the storm before the rider ignores it?
Can the finish be located before the ending?

W09-P33.emotional_spine: A quiet host sees something he values violated, chooses retaliation, and meets an opponent capable of countering.
W09-P33.ground_plan: The truck enters along the west pitch edge and turns near the east goal. Red can reach a low terrace beside that turn. Beyond it is a narrow stone service passage: solid masonry can stop a truck, loose netting cannot.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: Red enjoys his soccer grounds with the center circle and goal intact. A distant lifted truck approaches the same entrance.
beats.what_changes: The reader sees what can be lost before destruction begins.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: Chins drives the lifted truck across the pitch; the tires tear a continuous track through the center circle and clip the goal structure.
beats.what_changes: Off-roading becomes a deliberate territorial violation.
beats.transition: Match the fresh rut to Red looking down at it.

W09-P33.page_turn_out: The pitch is damaged; what will Red do rather than merely glare?
text_hidden_review_questions: Does Red reach the hood from a shown terrace?
Is the stopping force stone/ground rather than an implausible net?

W09-P34.emotional_spine: The cookout host wants to own the occasion; a familiar dominant visitor challenges that pride in public.
W09-P34.ground_plan: The town cookout is temporary dressing beside Chili Stable. A low serving platform holds a ribbon and table; a wheeled vat of cooled serving chili sits on the shallow ramp beside it. Dark Horse and its cart harness are visible off the crowd lane.
anchors: cooled chili vat, ramp and Dark Horse harness

beats.pose_and_physical_action: Chili works the serving station while townsfolk gather. Show the wheeled serving vat, its chock, ramp and Dark Horse harness naturally within the frame.
beats.what_changes: Hospitality and the eventual comic mechanism are established together.
beats.transition: The crowd’s attention shifts toward the arriving Belt Keeper.

beats.shot: Low medium at the edge of the tables
beats.pose_and_physical_action: HMB steps in wearing his approved hooded, red-eyed, black-armored identity and belt. Chili pauses with a ladle before resuming a deliberately confident welcome.
beats.what_changes: A lively cookout becomes a personal test.
beats.transition: Match their eyelines to the prize ribbon and serving platform.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: Chili presents the dish; HMB inspects it and takes space at the platform. No crown, royal court or invented real league judging rule.
beats.what_changes: Both characters try to control the public encounter.
beats.transition: Turn on the unresolved struggle over the host’s stage.

open sand ring and Highland skyline

northeast wedge with rear tree line

beats.what_changes: The reader learns lanes before rapid cutting begins.
